_notes: Standalone resolution: config.json lives beside this skill. Set harness_root.resolver to an absolute or ~-prefixed Python file to opt in to that module's path resolution. Unset roadmaps and standards use the ~/.claude/roadmaps and ~/.claude/standards defaults. Relative source values join their configured roadmaps or standards directory; absolute source values remain explicit, and ~-prefixed source values expand against HOME instead of joining that directory. A missing optional source degrades to one one-line notice. An install that keeps its own routing documents points these source keys at them from ~/.claude/skill-config/sharpen.json; the shipped values are neutral defaults.
